Game Overview

In Something Below The Sea, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the depths as you control drones tasked with cleaning oceans of trash. Uncover mysteries lurking beneath the waves while navigating this immersive aquatic world, full of unexpected secrets and challenges. Explore, clean, and protect the marine ecosystem in an adventure that blends strategy and discovery.
